data.heading: Frequently asked questions
data.subheading: Straight answers about how we work with clients.

items.question: What does an initial consultation cost?
items.answer: The first 30-minute consultation is free of charge. If we proceed, we agree a fixed fee or hourly rate in writing before any work begins.

items.question: How quickly will you respond?
items.answer: We reply to every enquiry within one working day, and urgent matters are triaged the same afternoon.

items.question: Will my case go to court?
items.answer: Most disputes settle before a hearing. We prepare every file as if it will go to trial, which is often what produces a fair settlement.

items.question: Who will handle my matter?
items.answer: A named partner leads each matter and you will always have a direct line to them.
